record.where: Karma & the Republic (v3.22 — two coins, the quiet work, and the mountain come down)

clauses.text: the tiered ledger and its chip
RENEGADE is what the road knows you are willing to do: a global name that only grows — Clean Hands, Grey Hand, Road's Own, Free Walker
landing as its own bandana-marked chip
the green-never-gold crates
Elm's far lean-to offers two crates of highleaf smokes in OUTLAW GREEN — the contra band, never the Order's gold

figure.note: L at the lean-to puts exactly two contra crates on the back

clauses.text: the three-way clean pay
Passed CLEAN it pays three ways at once — trust, renegade, and the buyer's appreciation RISES, because the town wanted them
the visible smoke
the yard shows it: loungers on the steps, embers, a lazy ribbon of smoke for ten minutes

figure.note: the yard's smoke clock, set at the pass, reads 600 s (taken within the next ten)

clauses.text: the Republic's arrival
At fifteen percent coverage — or the moment the road first learns your name — the mountain takes notice: the banner, and the founding letter

figure.note: the valley is lit town by town from under 15% to past it and the arrival comes; the line itself is not sampled from below

clauses.text: Two peoples, one wire
per-town heat on a caught pass with seizure and mail
CAUGHT, the crates are ash and HEAT lands at that town alone (Bannerlord's per-territory lesson): a colder keeper, a mark in the ledger
settlement and decay
which cools with time, or is settled at the terminal for coin
the legible risk equation
an armed watch has eyes (+20%)

figure.note: an armed yard by day reads 0.65 against the bare yard's 0.45

clauses.text: daylight tells (+15%)

figure.note: the bare yard reads 0.45 by day on the equation's 0.30

clauses.text: night is kind (−10%)

figure.note: the bare yard reads 0.20 by night on the equation's 0.30

clauses.text: and a known grey hand slips easier
the skim
the fixer posts THE SKIM — a counting-room cutpurse job at a named town, same equation, heavier fall
the measured camp-claim respect and its gold exception
raider camps keep a fifteen-percent shorter claim and their shouts change — "Road's own. Eyes forward, boys."

figure.note: at 92% of the claim the Road's Own is left alone while a Clean Hands is chased, and at 80% the knives still come: the shorter edge lies between, 85% itself is not sampled

clauses.text: Put the Order's gold on your back and business is business again
the seeded named wards and their heavy intercept
Farkeeper WARDS join the fires — named, drawn a head taller and a hand wider in iron and pale
hired as companions who meet trouble first and hit like the mountain
the corrected strings
The lore correction lands everywhere at once: every rider who ever answered your horn was a FARKEEPER rider, in every line the player reads
NOT giants
breed data and the measured Arabian
Five horse breeds with stats where their real strengths are

figure.note: the breeds are exactly mustang, fjord, arabian, percheron, icelandic

clauses.text: the Fjord stands its ground when scrappers hit, the Arabian measurably outruns everything and spooks at shadows, the Percheron was born to carry — and every stable keeps its town's horse
eight cultured factions

figure.note: v3.25 stepped the exiles' two out of rumour: the check asserts the eight and the two beside them, ten in all

clauses.text: each with a culture and a palette
the karma panel
read in the character sheet under a heading that says it plainly: NOT GOOD AND BAD. TWO COINS, BOTH YOURS
save/reload
